provenance.note: Revolvers with a barrel up to 4.25 in and pistols that fit the 220 x 140 x 40 mm box (C.6D.1). The course runs at 20, 15 and 10 m, the record holds the longest distance. The barrel limit is stated for revolvers; pistols are limited by a gauge box. Any bullet shape except wadcutter is allowed.
